description: Eight knobs, each sending its own voltage out and each with a text box for writing what it is for

params.text: Sets the voltage that goes to the jack above it, from -5V to 5V

outputs.text: Carries the voltage of the knob below it

notes: the box under each knob is for typing a label; nothing in the module reads what is typed there.
the module's own code for saving those labels reads a pointer it never sets, so a label is not reliably kept when a patch is saved and reloaded.
the text boxes are plain widgets rather than controls, so clicking one cannot bring up help for it.
